author: Revolutionized-IoT2
name: RIoT2 device plugin
description: A RIoT2 device plugin repository: PluginBase, an async sample device with typed options, the conformance test, the plugin zip on dotnet publish, CI and release workflows and the documentation set.

CoreVersion.description: The RIoT2.Core.Devices version to build on. The node installs a plugin only with the same major and a minor no newer than its own, so pick the oldest Core your nodes run.

DisplayName.description: The plugin's name in the node's PluginManifest.json and the UI.
